name: HD 80607

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list HD 80606 and HD 80607 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 1019003226022657920 and 1019003329101872896), 1,355 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 3.6e-6: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to HD 80606, 1,355 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 457134361 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

mass.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 457134361 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 457134361 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: HD 80607 is a star of 5,538 K, bound to HD 80606 1,355 AU away.
text.introduction: HD 80607 shares its motion through space with HD 80606, 1,355 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: HD 80607's orbit around HD 80606 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
